definitions.gloss: boarding, getting on (a train, bus, car)
definitions.explanation: The act of getting on a ground vehicle such as a train, bus, or car.

examples.japanese: {乗車|じょうしゃ}する{前|まえ}に{切符|きっぷ}を{買|か}ってください。
examples.english: Please buy a ticket before boarding.

examples.japanese: {乗車|じょうしゃ}{位置|いち}は{黄色|きいろ}い{線|せん}の{内側|うちがわ}です。
examples.english: The boarding position is inside the yellow line.

examples.japanese: {乗車|じょうしゃ}{拒否|きょひ}された。

notes:
USAGE: {乗車|じょうしゃ} is used for getting on trains, buses, and cars. For aircraft, use {搭乗|とうじょう} instead.

AS A SURU VERB: {乗車|じょうしゃ}する (to board)

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
・{乗車券|じょうしゃけん} (train ticket, boarding ticket)
・{乗車|じょうしゃ}{位置|いち} (boarding position)
・{乗車|じょうしゃ}{拒否|きょひ} (refusal of boarding)
・{乗車|じょうしゃ}{時間|じかん} (boarding time)
・{乗車|じょうしゃ}{定員|ていいん} (passenger capacity)

ANTONYM: {降車|こうしゃ} (getting off, alighting)

RELATED TERMS:
・{搭乗|とうじょう} - boarding (aircraft, ship)
・{下車|げしゃ} - alighting, getting off
